mapper.select: SELECT o.*, u.nickname AS customer_nickname, ub.nickname AS booster_nickname FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.customer_id = u.id LEFT JOIN users ub ON o.booster_id = ub.id WHERE o.id = #{id}
SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE customer_id = #{customerId}

SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending'
AND game = #{game}
SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE booster_id = #{boosterId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (game, service_type, detail, price, status, customer_id, booster_id, cs_id, source_channel, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{game}, #{serviceType}, #{detail}, #{price}, #{status}, #{customerId}, #{boosterId}, #{csId}, #{sourceChannel}, now(), now())
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = #{status}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE orders SET booster_id = #{boosterId}, status = 'assigned', updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'pending'
UPDATE orders SET booster_id = #{boosterId}, cs_id = #{csId}, status = 'assigned', updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'pending'
